_doc: Role-based contacts. One entry per ROLE, never per person, so a change of officer is a one-line edit. `status` drives both the UI and REVIEW.md: ok = published and unambiguous; conflict = the legacy site published two different values and one is wrong; missing = the legacy site never published it. Nothing here is invented — a missing value stays null.
